facts.fact: On 17 June 2026 APD executive administrator Amaro Figueiredo said the Lei de Protecção de Dados is under revision, the public consultation is complete and the bill is expected to go to the Council of Ministers and then the National Assembly in the next legislative year.
The APD's executive administrator, Amaro Figueiredo, spoke for the authority on 17 June 2026 at a workshop it organised.
